content.title: Set up Docusaurus documentation site
content.description:
Set up Docusaurus (or similar static site generator) to serve the hand-written markdown documentation from docs/markdown/ as a proper documentation website.

This depends on mpdwq7dvls (user-friendly markdown docs) being completed first.

Scope:
- Install and configure Docusaurus in the repo (likely as a separate package or at repo root)
- Configure Docusaurus to consume docs/markdown/ as content source
- Set up GitHub Pages or similar deployment from the built site
- Configure navigation/sidebar from the 8 doc sections
- Update release workflow to build and deploy docs site on release
- Ensure markdown files work for both raw reading and Docusaurus rendering

Out of scope: content writing (handled by mpdwq7dvls), choosing between Docusaurus/VitePress/etc (evaluate when this becomes active).
